Command: Put On the Whole Armour of God
Summary: Paul's armour command: put on the whole armour of God, that you may stand against the wiles of the devil, and having done all, stand.
Commandment: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Application: The armour is God's own, piece by piece — truth, righteousness, gospel peace, faith, salvation, the word — and the posture is standing, not advancing by human strength. Prayer on all occasions closes the list.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: 'for we wrestle not against flesh and blood' (Ephesians 6:12).
